'''Arkanis''' was the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]]. It was inhabited by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] such as [[Devon Fuller]]. It was the capital of the [[Regency Worlds/Legends|Arkanis Regency]], which included the ancient Empress [[Teeda]]. The planet was part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was the location of [[Vensenor Flight Academy/Legends|Vensenor Flight Academy]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] set up camp on Arkanis.<ref name="TOR:MM">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Mandalorian Mercenaries}}</ref> The [[Exchange]] attempted to deliver lethal weapons to the mercenaries on Arkanis.<ref name="TOR:AI">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Arkanis Interception}}</ref>
